$comment: Source instruments used to develop and test ingestion. Every entry records where the
document came from and a checksum, so an extracted clause can always be proved to have
come from this exact file (spec §5.1 provenance, G-14 integrity).
These are official government publications, committed so that ingestion is reproducible
offline and in CI. They are NOT seed data: nothing here is loaded into a customer
deployment. A customer ingests their own applicable instruments.
retrievalMethod records how the file was obtained, because it matters:
indiacode.nic.in serves its files behind Akamai and refuses non-browser requests, so
manual upload is a first-class path, not a fallback (spec §5.2).

instruments.title: The Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975
instruments.notes: The spike anchor. §6 (Returns) carries a duty, a statutory evidence requirement (treasury challan), escalating late fees (₹200/₹1,000), sub-clause hierarchy and amendment markers. Its cadence is deferred to the Rules.

instruments.title: The Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Rules, 1975
instruments.authority: Government of Maharashtra — Department of Goods and Services Tax
instruments.notes: Supplies the cadence Act §6 defers to, and it is conditional on the employer's liability: under ₹1,00,000 annual by 31 March, ₹1,00,000 or more monthly by month end. Filed on Form III/III-B with a treasury challan. OCR text layer — extraction confidence must be recorded per clause.

instruments.title: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 2013
instruments.notes: The parent instrument the PFRDA circular cites (s.14, duties and powers of the Authority). s.28 carries penalties, feeding severity derived from consequence.

instruments.title: Extension of Incentive Framework under National Pension System (NPS) — NPS e-shramik (Platform Service Partner) Model for FY 2026-27
instruments.authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
instruments.notes: Two pages, four numbered clauses. Smallest instrument in the set and the best test of the relation graph: it supersedes an earlier circular and cites a section of its parent Act. Bilingual — English then Hindi; the segmenter must stop at the language boundary.
